remaining_concerns: Evidence is weighted toward crisis-era stabilization and sanctions response, with fewer direct measures of long-run productivity, investment, or household welfare.
Most strong direct items come from Reuters and the Bank of Russia; the rest of the file is mainly corroborating macro context rather than independent domestic performance evidence.
